## Football effect

Harris played 70 defensive snaps with six tackles, the last of them the third-and-8 stop of Foles's scramble that ended the possession on which the injury was logged. On the projection he misses the next three months, through the Week 14 game against Houston; his availability follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. His roster disposition (carried on the 53, reserve/injured, or the designation for return) is Caldwell's decision with the user and is pending; the Week 2 starting cornerback opposite Talib is Stone's decision after the September 8 review, with Verner and Bouye the chart's next outside men.
